Name: Liliet's Multiple Spouses Dialogue Pack - now with Krobus
Author: LilietBorodina
Description:
The dialogue pack assumes by default that you are married to all [s]four[/s] five, but it'll work if you're married to any two, too, and for Krobus's pack, Krobus and literally anyone else. There are [s]three[/s] four subpacks, AND THE MAIN FILE CONTAINS ALL FOUR:

- [b]Haley is cute[/b]: a dialogue pack where Haley is her charming self with any and all of the other three. If you aren't married to Haley, it won't do anything, but if you're married to Haley and anyone else of them, it's fully recommended. Haley suggests makeovers, lightheartedly bickers with Abigail and loves their music.

- [b]Band practice[/b]: a dialogue pack where Abigail, Sam and Sebastian continue their band activities while married to you. Doesn't mention Haley at all. Works as long as you're married to any two.

- [b]Game night[/b]: a dialogue pack where Abigail, Sam and Sebastian have a regular game night, and are teaching Haley to play, too. Works if you're married to literally any two of them, though you might want to imagine the other two visit and join in - two people make for a very small game night...

- [b]Welcome Krobus[/b]: a dialogue pack where Krobus and the valley youngsters navigate the challenges of cultural exchange. Featuring pranks, weird questions and talking behind Krobus's back... which he can take offense to! Featuring love, support and acceptance as well. The challenges are great, but they will be overcome!

If you want any one or two or three, download the ones you want, they are compatible. If you want all four, download the main file.

Updates possibly coming if I come up with more ideas for the four of them (or anyone else, possibly Krobus, we'll see). I take (and will credit here) suggestions, though I'm not interested in overtly sexual/romantic content.

---

Other mods showcased on the screenshot: Seasonal Villager Outfits, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13906]Less Ugly Spouse Rooms
[/url]﻿
See also my other mods, both minor dialogue fixes: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17842]Haley Reads Magazines[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17963]Not In Here By Yourself
[/url]﻿
Shoutout to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8840]Tia's Multiple Spouses Dialogue Pack[/url]﻿ which gave me the push to make this one and is both wonderful and fully compatible!

---

Note: this pack assumes that you will see spouse dialogues periodically while passing by, not stay and watch the spouses cycle through them. Some of them will not sound natural that way, and they are definitely not meant to sound natural when repeated multiple times in a row.
